hyps.why: Replacing a missing edge into the output with a 3x3 conv adds a whole path, so the gain is larger than when replacing an existing op.
Filling an empty edge with a conv gives a larger gain than swapping one existing op for another.
Edge 0 is the sole entry to node 1, so replacing none with a conv opens up the whole node-1 branch.
Adding a direct input-to-output skip where none existed improves gradient flow more than replacing a conv with a skip.
Replacing a useful skip with a conv gains less, or loses, compared with replacing none.
Removing a strong conv edge into the output hurts more than removing a weak op.
With edge 0 removed, node 1 has no input, so edge 2 is dead and the edit has no effect.
With edge 0 removed, edge 4 starts from a dead node and cannot contribute.
With edge 0 removed, edge 1 is the only way to feed node 2, so a conv there matters much more.
With edge 1 removed, all deep paths pass through edge 0, so improving it has a larger effect.
